breaking.change: A restart event payload mismatch reports the first differing event's zero-based index and fields (with start and now values) in restart.diff.events, and names its index, field and values in restart.first, instead of reporting only queue counts.
breaking.fix: Read index and fields for payload differences; start and now on each event queue remain its counts. Entity fields still compare through the same structural pairing as components; event order remains significant.
